fields.statement: Verifier at 40c4123c: read the diff (stepPattern now repeats /segment any number of times, maxStep 120). go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestStartStepNestedPaths passes: it accepts build, ship-change/build, ship-change/build/build, a/b/c/d and a 120-char three-segment path, and rejects a//b, /a, a/, a/b/, upper case, double dashes, trailing/leading dash and a 121-char path.
